title: Group
description: A Microsoft Entra security group or Microsoft 365 group managed via Microsoft Graph

id.description: Unique identifier for the group object (read-only)

mailNickname.description: Mail alias for the group (without domain suffix)

mailEnabled.description: Specifies whether the group is mail-enabled

securityEnabled.description: Specifies whether the group is a security group

groupTypes.description: Collection specifying the group type and dynamic membership. Unified = Microsoft 365 group.

visibility.description: Visibility of a Microsoft 365 group content and members list

membershipRule.description: Rule defining dynamic group membership (requires DynamicMembership in groupTypes)

membershipRuleProcessingState.description: Indicates whether dynamic membership processing is on or paused

onPremisesSyncEnabled.description: True if the group is synced from on-premises Active Directory

createdDateTime.description: Timestamp when the group was created

renewedDateTime.description: Timestamp when the Microsoft 365 group was last renewed

expirationDateTime.description: Timestamp when the group expires (requires an expiration policy)

preferredDataLocation.description: Preferred data location for multi-geo tenant (e.g. CAN, EUR)

resourceProvisioningOptions.description: Resources provisioned (e.g. Team for Microsoft Teams-enabled groups)
